verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers mail sending, sandbox mode, event webhooks, domain authentication, and deliverability dashboards, but contains no mention of a Suppressions API (bounces, blocks, spam reports, unsubscribes) or any endpoint for reading/managing suppression lists programmatically. Missing for 10: documentation or reference to the Suppression Management API endpoints (GET/DELETE bounces, blocks, invalid emails, spam reports, unsubscribe groups), any first-party or community confirmation that platform engineers can query/remove suppressed addresses via API.
